release_notes: Email & Webmail overhaul. Webmail (SnappyMail): rebranded to 'Planet Hosts Mail' with a custom PlanetHosts theme (dark navy #0b1f39 / #1683ff) pulled from the primary site branding (admin/branding company_name syncs into the webmail title). Webmail is now served at the root of port 2096 and the /snappymail/ path is hidden (redirects to :2096) on the panel and main site. Email administration page now mirrors the /admin/account design (stats cards, mailbox groups by domain, search/filter, icon actions). Email wired to the real mail system (PostfixAdmin SQLite with {BLF-CRYPT}); accounts read from the live mailbox store; per-account Change Password updates Dovecot auth. Root mailbox read (password override): admins can open any mailbox and view messages (subject/from/date/body/raw) for spam/abuse investigations. Server Email alerts: designate any mailbox as the Server Email; a cron checks it every minute and creates alerts ('New email to X - From: Y | Subject: Z'); a global sticky banner pops on every admin page when a new alert arrives (like the update banner). Also fixed a critical mail delivery bug: Postfix virtual mailbox map now delivers into Maildir/ so mail is visible in Dovecot/webmail (was delivering to a path Dovecot never read).
